What is textbook and what is Brute's: homing sequences (Moore 1956; Kohavi), the Vasilevskii-Chow test-suite shape (1973 / 1978) and the Rivest-Schapire homing-sequence learner (1993) are textbook. Brute contributes the certificate: the label comes only from Brute's SAT version space (certify/32p, unchanged) proving by UNSAT that no machine with <= N states consistent with the whole reset-free trajectory predicts a different future. It does not assume the homing sequence is correct. The textbook baseline's label is conditional on its homing sequence really homing the target, which it cannot check.
Clean readings only (no noise arm in this study). Small real targets of 6 to 13 states; not a capability leap.
